subject: basic-computing
title: Workplace Practices and Work Management
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: What should be your self-management skills whenever you feel overstressed?
questions.answer: Divert your attention to something enjoyable such as music, a chat or a walk, take deep breaths and take a short break.

questions.q: How can you say that 'punctuality is one of the best workplace practices'?
questions.answer: Being on time earns respect from everyone, helps manage work and keeps you aware of updates and happenings.

questions.q: Name any two workplace practices which are universally acceptable.
questions.answer: Be punctual; be aware of your role; respect others; communicate clearly; build the team (any two).

questions.q: What is meant by Self management?
questions.answer: Honest knowledge of oneself and managing one's emotions, stress and anger by using strengths and converting weaknesses into strengths.

questions.q: Explain any two work management tips.
questions.answer: Plan with a to-do list and prioritize work by urgency; take short breaks to manage stress (also follow guidelines, stay updated).

questions.q: What is an organizational chart?
questions.answer: A diagram that depicts the structure of an organization and its reporting hierarchy.

questions.q: Name the life skill promoted by WHO that is the honest knowledge of self.
questions.answer: Self awareness.

questions.q: Communication in the workplace should be clear, ______ and effective.
questions.answer: Concise.

questions.q: Which document helps to prioritize daily work?
questions.answer: A 'To Do' list.

questions.q: Is anger a solution to stress? Why?
questions.answer: No; it robs calmness and paralyses thinking.

questions.q: What is the use of deep breathing at the workplace?
questions.answer: It lowers stress, reduces anxiety and helps control anger.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: Explain the work management tips: plan, prioritize and take timeout.
questions.answer: Plan with an updated to-do list; prioritize by urgency and time to focus on one work at a time; take short breaks to manage stress and think better.

questions.q: Why is it important to manage anger?
questions.answer: Anger harms health, relationships and career, robs calmness and paralyses thinking.

questions.q: What do you understand by the term workplace?
questions.answer: An environment where people work to produce a product or provide a service.

questions.q: Highlight the importance of communication in the workplace.
questions.answer: It connects colleagues, superiors, subordinates and customers; clear, concise and effective communication avoids mistakes and improves teamwork.

questions.q: Why is team building important at the workplace?
questions.answer: No one works in isolation; teamwork with mutual trust and accountability helps achieve goals efficiently.

questions.q: Why should you be grateful and never boast at work?
questions.answer: Gratitude gives credit and builds rapport; boasting is avoided because recognition is a by-product of sincere work.

questions.q: Why is it important to know the organizational chart?
questions.answer: It shows workflow, reporting supervisors and subordinates and gives clarity of communication.

questions.q: What is meant by 'Follow guidelines' in work management?
questions.answer: Carefully reading instructions and formats before starting work, so there is no delay or wasted work.

questions.q: How does ineffective work management lead to anger?
questions.answer: It creates stress due to missed deadlines, which when not managed gets converted into anger.

questions.q: Why should one stay updated with technology at work? Give an example.
questions.answer: New tools make work faster, e.g. mail merge for 100 letters and labels or Google Docs for collaborative review.

sections.title: Answer the questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: List and explain the workplace practices.
questions.answer: Be punctual; know your role; know the organizational chart; communicate clearly and concisely; build the team; respect others and their working environment.

questions.q: List and explain the work management tips.
questions.answer: Plan, prioritize, stay updated, take timeout, follow guidelines, communicate, be grateful and never boast.

questions.q: Write and explain the steps to manage anger.
questions.answer: Be thoughtful; express yourself in control; divert your attention; avoid blame; deep breathing; seek help if you cannot manage.

questions.q: Explain self awareness and why it matters for self management.
questions.answer: It is honest knowledge of self (strengths and weaknesses); using strengths and converting weaknesses helps manage oneself, stress and anger.

questions.q: Why is communication important in workplace practices and work management?
questions.answer: Clear, concise communication with colleagues, seniors and customers prevents errors, lets you seek help, and builds trust and teamwork.

questions.q: Explain how stress at work leads to anger and how to avoid it.
questions.answer: Poor planning causes pressure and stress, which turns into anger affecting health and career; plan and prioritize, take breaks, divert attention and practise deep breathing.
